name: CAMPHOR / MENTHOL / EUCALYPTUS / TURPENTINE / METHYL SALICYLATE OINTMENT 1 PIECE
description: Traditional ointment that helps decongest the respiratory tract and reduce chest and back pain caused by the flu. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
